title_en: The Wolf Among Us Remastered Leads the ID@Xbox October 2026 Showcase: Here Is Everything You Need to Know to Watch IGN's Massive Indie Livestream
summary_en: Find out how to watch the ID@Xbox October 2026 Showcase on IGN, including start times, streaming platforms, and included games like at The Wolf Among Us Remastered.
body_en:
IGN and Xbox are teaming up once again to bring you a brand-new edition of the ID@Xbox showcase. On October 20, we’ll be presenting exclusive reveals from tons of new and upcoming games that are headed to Xbox and PC.
This year’s livestream will include trailers, gameplay, and more from 20 incredible games, including:
These are only a few of the games that will appear in a showcase that will be jam-packed with exclusives, first looks, and new games you’ll definitely want to check out.
The October edition of the ID@Xbox Showcase Presented by IGN will kick off on Tuesday, October 20 at 10am PT / 1pm ET / 6pm BST. You can catch it wherever you watch IGN, including the following platforms:
We can confirm that The Wolf Among Us Remastered and gameplay from Critical Reflex Games will be present at next week’s ID@Xbox Showcase. Beyond that, you’ll have to tune in to find out what’s in store.
April’s ID@Xbox Showcase featured tons of exclusive reveals from games like There Are No Ghosts at the Grand, Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School, Solo Leveling Arise Overdrive, Tears of Metal, and many more. Be sure to tune in October 20 to see what this month’s show has to offer.
